title: Prairie Ridge Family Premium Schedule by Eligibility Category
content:
Of the seven eligibility categories of the Medicaid Managed Care Membership, only Prairie Ridge CHIP Kids bills a monthly family premium. The premium is set by a ladder of household income bands, matched on the whole percent of the federal poverty level on the membership, with both ends of each band inclusive.

## Prairie Ridge CHIP Kids premium ladder

| Household income band (% FPL, both ends inclusive) | Monthly family premium |
|---|---|
| 148 to 185 | $20.00 |
| 186 to 210 | $35.00 |
| 211 to 235 | $50.00 |

## Premium terms by category

| Category | Premium ladder | Due day (day of the month before the coverage month) | Grace days after the due date | Lockout days after a non-payment termination | Most future months prepayable in one payment | Most hardship-waived months in a rolling 12 months | American Indian or Alaska Native members exempt | Unpaid premium past grace ends coverage |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Prairie Ridge Expansion Adult | None (never billed) | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | Yes | No |
| Prairie Ridge Family Care | None (never billed) | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | Yes | No |
| Prairie Ridge CHIP Kids | The ladder above | 20 | 60 | 90 | 3 | 3 | Yes | Yes |
| Prairie Ridge Children's Medicaid | None (never billed) | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | Yes | No |
| Prairie Ridge Pregnancy Care | None (never billed) | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | Yes | No |
| Prairie Ridge ABD Care | None (never billed) | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | Yes | No |
| Prairie Ridge Dual Complete | None (never billed) | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | Yes | No |

A 0 in the day and month columns means that no premium is billed in the category, so the term has nothing to apply to.

## What each term means

- **Due day.** The premium for a coverage month is due on this calendar day of the month before the coverage month; in Prairie Ridge CHIP Kids, the 20th.
- **Grace days.** Calendar days after the due date during which an unpaid premium does not yet end coverage; in Prairie Ridge CHIP Kids, 60.
- **Lockout days.** Calendar days after a termination for premium non-payment during which the family cannot re-enroll in the category unless the past-due premium is paid; in Prairie Ridge CHIP Kids, 90.
- **Prepayment limit.** The most future coverage months a family may prepay in one payment; in Prairie Ridge CHIP Kids, 3.
- **Hardship waiver limit.** The most coverage months that may be waived for financial hardship within a rolling 12-month period; in Prairie Ridge CHIP Kids, 3.
- **American Indian or Alaska Native exemption.** In every category, members recorded as American Indian or Alaska Native are exempt from premiums.
- **Non-payment ends coverage.** Only in Prairie Ridge CHIP Kids does an unpaid premium past the grace period end coverage.

## Hypothetical band lookups

*Hypothetical incomes, read against the Prairie Ridge CHIP Kids ladder.*

| Income on the membership | Band | Monthly premium |
|---|---|---|
| 185 percent | 148 to 185 (top of band, inclusive) | $20.00 |
| 186 percent | 186 to 210 (bottom of band, inclusive) | $35.00 |
| 210 percent | 186 to 210 | $35.00 |
| 211 percent | 211 to 235 | $50.00 |

A hypothetical coverage month of September has its premium due on 20 August.
